caption: I sell braai plates to pay for my own degree. How much did you spend on varsity food?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R6 200 p/m
as a student
Living in Alice
slides.body:
Male, 20
Single, second year at Fort Hare
Income: NSFAS living allowance + braai plates on weekends
Net income: R6 200 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: A room off campus, shared bathroom, wifi included
slides.body: It's R1 800 because the landlord is the aunt of a classmate. Without that it's R2 600.

slides.title: Food
slides.includes: Rice, eggs, cabbage, two braai plates a week I make for myself
slides.body: I buy the braai meat wholesale and sell eleven plates a weekend. I eat the twelfth.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My mom, from the braai plate money
slides.body: She says don't. I send it anyway.

slides.title: Sneakers lay-by
slides.body: I know. I know. They're white.

slides.title: Taxi home
slides.body: It's the one trip I won't skip.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Data, airtime, electricity, funeral policy, a varsity stokvel, laundry & toiletries
slides.body: R120 of that is a funeral policy my mom made me take at 18. I've never told her it's the best R120 I spend.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R6 200. It's R6 a day. It's a lot more than it sounds like when you're twenty.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statements to Beyond Horizon and it sorted every transaction.

The sneakers were the shock.

No bank login needed.
